claim: PRU offers dinner (The PRU Experience) for THB 7,200++ per person and lunch for THB 4,000++, with a kappo-style open kitchen and community-to-fork philosophy
quote: We took down the wall between the kitchen and the dining room so guests can see, smell and taste what we do.

claim: PRU holds a 2026 Michelin Star and Green Star, situated at Trisara resort with panoramic ocean views; dinner Tue–Sat 18:00–22:30, lunch Fri–Sat 12:00–15:00

claim: Specific courses include durian with Hua Hin caviar, 100-day dry-aged mackerel dashi, honey-lemongrass duck, coconut ceviche, and cashew fruit kimchi ice cream; custom ceramics by InClay Studio, Chiang Mai

claim: TripAdvisor rating 4.4/5 from 149 reviews; notable dishes mentioned include aged duck with tamarind, black crab with fermented tea, mackerel with makhwaen pepper
quote: Michelin star that's fun and friendly with an incredibly welcoming team

claim: Portions are small; 8-course menu recommended even for modest appetites; older pricing showed 6-course at THB 4,680 and 8-course at THB 5,850 all-in
